title: Accelerated Consensus and Decentralized Optimization over Slowly Varying Networks
summary: We study average consensus over slowly time-varying networks and its application to decentralized optimization. We introduce WAVE, a windowed Chebyshev method that limits the accumulated effect of network variation by restarting the recurrence after finite windows. If $χ$ bounds the network condition number and successive communication operators satisfy $\|L_{k+1}-L_k\|\leqβ$, WAVE reaches $ε$-consensus in $O((\sqrtχ+\min\lbraceβχ^2,χ\rbrace)\ln(e/ε))$ communication rounds.
